caption: The drawing depicts a metal stove with an angular, box-like body and standing on four straight legs. The stove is primarily grayish-blue with patches of brown, suggesting areas of rust or wear. There is a semi-circular handle affixed to the slanted front panel for opening the stove’s main compartment. A metallic cylindrical chimney protrudes vertically from the top right section of the stove and has two horizontal rings and several evenly spaced circular holes near its top. The composition features the main stove centrally placed within a large lightly outlined red rectangle, and in the upper left corner, a smaller rectangle contains a simple line drawing of the stove, viewed from a similar angle, highlighting additional details like the chimney cover and overall shape. The background is an uncolored, off-white paper. The bottom right corner contains a signature and a date.
title: Tin Stove
